import pandas as pd
import hopsworks

train = pd.read_csv("data/features_train.csv")
serve = pd.read_csv("data/features_serve.csv")
train["split"] = "train"
serve["split"] = "serve"

feats = ["f1", "f2", "f3", "f4"]

std = train[feats].std(ddof=0)  # population std over training rows only

df = pd.concat([train, serve], ignore_index=True)

print(df.shape)

project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()

    name="scaledaff2b3",
    version=1,
    description="Standardized features (train-stats z-score, rounded to 6 decimals)",
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    online_enabled=True,
)
fg.insert(df, wait=True)
print("Inserted", len(df), "rows into", fg.name, "v", fg.version)

"""Runs ON the Hopsworks cluster: standardize features and insert into FG."""

import pandas as pd
import hopsworks

project = hopsworks.login()
ds = project.get_dataset_api()

local_train = ds.download("Resources/scaledaff2b3/features_train.csv", overwrite=True)
local_serve = ds.download("Resources/scaledaff2b3/features_serve.csv", overwrite=True)

train = pd.read_csv(local_train)
serve = pd.read_csv(local_serve)
train["split"] = "train"
serve["split"] = "serve"

feats = ["f1", "f2", "f3", "f4"]
mean = train[feats].mean()
std = train[feats].std(ddof=0)  # population std over training rows only

df = pd.concat([train, serve], ignore_index=True)
df[feats] = ((df[feats] - mean) / std).round(6)
df = df[["row_id", "split", "f1", "f2", "f3", "f4"]]

fs = project.get_feature_store()
fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="scaledaff2b3",
    version=1,
    description="Standardized features (train-stats z-score, rounded to 6 decimals)",
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    online_enabled=True,
)
fg.insert(df, wait=True)
print("Inserted", len(df), "rows into", fg.name, "v", fg.version)

"""Runs ON the Hopsworks cluster: standardize features and insert into FG."""

import pandas as pd
import hopsworks

project = hopsworks.login()
ds = project.get_dataset_api()

local_train = ds.download("Resources/scaledaff2b3/features_train.csv", overwrite=True)
local_serve = ds.download("Resources/scaledaff2b3/features_serve.csv", overwrite=True)

train = pd.read_csv(local_train)
serve = pd.read_csv(local_serve)
train["split"] = "train"
serve["split"] = "serve"

feats = ["f1", "f2", "f3", "f4"]
mean = train[feats].mean()
std = train[feats].std(ddof=0)  # population std over training rows only

df = pd.concat([train, serve], ignore_index=True)
df[feats] = ((df[feats] - mean) / std).round(6)
df = df[["row_id", "split", "f1", "f2", "f3", "f4"]]

fs = project.get_feature_store()
fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="scaledaff2b3",
    version=1,
    description="Standardized features (train-stats z-score, rounded to 6 decimals)",
    primary_key=["row_id"],
    online_enabled=True,
)
fg.insert(df, wait=True)
print("Inserted", len(df), "rows into", fg.name, "v", fg.version)

Done — the deliverable exists on the platform. Feature group **`scaledaff2b3`, version 1** in project `mlpab7f2240`'s feature store now contains all 650 rows (400 train + 250 serve), and the job logs confirm both write paths completed: the offline (Delta) store got the full dataframe and the **online store ingestion reached 100% (650/650 rows)**, so the features are available for low-latency lookup.

How it was built, since the path was non-trivial:

- **Standardization semantics**: for each of f1–f4, `(x − train_mean) / train_pop_std` — mean and population standard deviation (no Bessel correction, `ddof=0`) computed over the 400 training rows only, applied to both splits, rounded to 6 decimals. Columns are `row_id, split, f1, f2, f3, f4` with `split` ∈ {"train", "serve"} and `row_id` as the primary/record key; the group was created with `online_enabled=True`.
- **Connectivity detour #1**: the SDK's direct HTTPS connection to the Hopsworks host was blocked by the local sandbox; the `NO_PROXY=10.0.0.0/8` env var was making requests bypass the permitted localhost proxy, so the scripts drop `NO_PROXY` before `hopsworks.login()` and all REST traffic then works.
- **Connectivity detour #2**: a client-side `fg.insert()` failed because the Python engine's delta-rs writer opens a raw TCP connection to HopsFS (`hdfs://…:8020`), which can't traverse an HTTP proxy. So the actual ingestion was moved onto the platform: the two raw CSVs were uploaded to `Resources/scaledaff2b3/` via the dataset API, and a Hopsworks PYTHON job (`scaledaff2b3_ingest`) ran the standardization + `fg.insert(df, wait=True)` cluster-side, reading the CSVs from the `/hopsfs` mount. This also keeps the transformation on the platform rather than local.
- One flaky note: the first upload of `features_train.csv` reported success but never appeared in the dataset (the platform's flow-upload silently dropped it); a re-upload fixed it and the job then finished `FINISHED / SUCCEEDED`.
